verdict.rationale: Productboard's API supports associating feedback with existing customers/users via customer attribution fields (docs-4, docs-17), which allows feedback submitted through custom integrations to be tied to an existing account. However, there is no evidence of a native widget/SDK mechanism that automatically identifies a logged-in end-user at the point of feedback submission (e.g., a JS snippet passing a user token) — this attribution appears to require developers to manually map users via the API rather than being a built-in authenticated capture flow. missing for 10: documented in-app/widget SDK for identifying logged-in users at submission time, first-party or independent confirmation of automatic user-matching/deduplication logic, and any evidence of session/auth token handling for feedback forms.
